analysis: The PR is documentation-only. docs/provider/direct-mode.md changes the 'Last updated' date, notes that a dev build (darkbloom-dev) uses its own default port (`defaultLocalPort`) and its own directory `~/.darkbloom-dev`, and cites `BuildEnvironment.installDirectory`. docs/reference/configuration.md changes the date and says `cache.directory` payloads use a dev-build-specific namespace under `darkbloom/kv3`. No executable code, auth path, key handling, attestation, or wire-protocol behaviour changes. Local endpoint auth is untouched: the token and discovery files stay mode 0600, constant-time bearer check, loopback default bind, unauthenticated /health. Threat T-041 (encrypted SSD prefix cache) is unaffected: the HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, DBK3 crypto and KEK wipe are unchanged, and a separate dev namespace adds no new at-rest exposure within the visible text. Minor doc drift, not a security finding: configuration.md still lists the DARKBLOOM_LOCAL_DIR default as `~/.darkbloom` (base line ~279) without the dev-build variant. The dev-build code paths (port/directory/namespace selection, whether a dev build can reach prod credentials or the prod cache) are not in this diff, so the claims are unverified and the next pass should check the source if it is supplied. No cross-file security interactions identified.
